subject: Request: One-time packaging & pilot discount exception for Vertex Labs (VP/CFO sign-off)
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@vertexlabs.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@vertexlabs.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot proposal & ask for a packaging concession

Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Vertex is excited to move quickly on a 6‑week pilot (hosted + optional dedicated burst) that will power our internal clinical search and a small set of agent workflows. To make the economics work for this pilot we need two exceptions to your standard packaging: a 40% pilot discount off list for 6 weeks, and a one‑time onboarding credit to cover data ingestion and configuration.

Key asks (short):
- 40% pilot discount on token charges for pilot term
- $18,000 one‑time onboarding credit (applied to first invoice)
- Commitment to revisit to a 12‑month minimum if pilot meets KPIs

We can sign a short SOW and are ready to provide a PO as soon as commercial is finalized. Can you confirm whether you can approve or route for exec signoff? We need a yes/no by Monday to keep the engineering slot.

Elena
Elena Soto
Head of AI Product, Vertex Labs

Attachments: Vertex_Commercial_Summary_Q2.pdf, Pilot_SOW_Vertx_v1.docx

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot proposal & ask for a packaging concession

Karthik / Markus — forwarding Vertex's ask. TL;DR: 40% off for a 6‑week pilot + $18k onboarding credit. They have clear intent to convert to an annual commitment if pilot KPIs are met; expected committed ARR ~ $350k/yr at renewal.

Why I’m escalating: this is outside standard pilot guardrails (max 30% and onboarding capped at $8k). Vertex is strategic (large healthcare data partner for our v2 integrations) and the engineering calendar is tight — if we don’t approve their slot they may push the pilot to a competitor.

Requested outcome: need VP/CFO pre‑approval of an exception path or a counter that protects revenue. Suggested mitigations:
- Approve 30% pilot discount now and structure the additional 10% as a one‑time retroactive credit only if conversion to a 12‑month committed deal is signed within 60 days.
- Approve $10k onboarding credit now and hold remaining $8k as a conversion milestone credit.

I’ve attached our commercial summary and a proposed SOW redline. Happy to jump on a 15 min call.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Pricing_Model_2027-06.xlsx, Pilot_SOW_Vertx_v1.docx

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot proposal & ask for a packaging concession

Marissa —

Thanks for the context and the suggested mitigations. Finance and commercial voice here: baseline guardrails exist to prevent excessive leakage on small pilots. Two concerns:
1) 40% on token unit costs without a firm revenue follow‑on risks negative unit economics given expected high inference volume during pilot.
2) Upfront onboarding credits are often underutilized as we see customers miss conversion deadlines.

If exec signoff is required, my recommended structured approval is:
- Approve up to 35% pilot discount immediately (exception) with the additional 5% conditional on executed 12‑month commitment within 45 days; the 5% that’s conditional should be documented as a repayable credit if conversion does not occur.
- Approve a $12k onboarding credit now; hold $6k as pay‑for‑performance: released after 2 successful KPI milestones in pilot.
- Add an explicit usage cap for the pilot (e.g., $120k token spend cap) and automatic throttling if exceeded; this protects against runaway costs.

If you want, I’ll draft the memo for VP/CFO signoff with a short cost impact table.

— Karthik Iyer
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: finance-approvals@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Pilot proposal & ask for a packaging concession

Markus / Karthik —

Thanks — please convert the recommendations into a short executive memo for VP/CFO signoff. Need the memo to include:
- One‑page decision ask (what we approve vs conditional items)
- Bullet cost impact estimate (best / likely / worst) for the pilot period and for first year if converted
- Draft redline paragraph for SOW and billing (credit timing, repayment clause, usage cap)
- Recommended escalation chain and timeline (we need a decision by EOD Monday 6/14 to keep Eng slot)

I’ll join to finalize and will copy the VP once the draft is ready.

— Marissa
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
